item_title: Adoption of an Official Park Name for a New Public Park at Senter Road and Serenade Way
document_text:
2.10 Adoption of an Official Park Name for a New Public Park at Senter Road and Serenade Way.
Adopt “Tsugio Fujimoto Park” as the official name for the park located along Senter Road between Serenade Way and Diamond Heights Drive, as recommended by staff and the Parks and Recreation Commission. Council District 2.

Councilmember Pamela Campos offered comment on Item 2.10 regarding the accomplishments of Tsugio Fujimoto.

Action: “Tsugio Fujimoto Park” was adopted as the official name for the park located along Senter Road between Serenade Way and Diamond Heights Drive. (11-0-0)
